# Somnus Labs - LLM Context File
# https://www.somnuslabs.com/llms.txt

> Somnus Labs builds AI products that ship faster, learn faster, and stay on-brand.

## Company Overview
Somnus Labs is an AI product studio founded in 2023. We build practical AI software for real estate and local businesses, with a human in the loop where money or reputation is on the line. Our products use multi-provider AI with automatic fallback.

## Products

### Deskwork
- URL: https://deskworkapp.com
- App: https://app.deskworkapp.com
- Purpose: Back office for independent real-estate brokerages
- Features:
  - Files, documents, and deadlines for every deal in one place
  - Commission plans, caps, and agent statements from each closing
  - Import an existing tracker; agents sign in with Google

### MagicReply
- URL: https://magicreply.ai
- App: https://app.magicreply.ai
- Purpose: AI replies to Google reviews that sound like your business
- Features:
  - On-brand reply drafts for every new review
  - Auto-reply rules, or approve each reply before it posts
  - Review analytics and team collaboration

### CMAForge
- URL: https://cmaforge.com
- App: https://app.cmaforge.com
- Purpose: AI-assisted comparative market analysis (CMA) reports for agents
- Features:
  - Seller and buyer CMA workflows with market-aware AI guidance
  - Appraisal-risk and pricing guidance, plus VA-ready checks
  - Branded reports and shareable client links

### ARV Analyzer
- URL: https://arvanalyzer.com
- Purpose: AI deal underwriting for fix-and-flip investors
- Features:
  - ARV, rehab estimate, and maximum allowable offer (MAO) from an address
  - Deal scoring, risk flags, and exit-strategy analysis
  - PDF export and shareable deal reports

### ListingPhoto
- URL: https://listingphoto.net
- Purpose: AI enhancement for real-estate listing photos
- Features:
  - Virtual staging, sky replacement, and object removal
  - Day-to-dusk, HDR, and perspective correction
  - Batch processing for a whole listing

### ListingReels
- URL: https://listingreels.net
- Purpose: Listing videos with AI presenters
- Features:
  - Scripts generated from the listing details
  - Choice of presenter, voice, and branding
  - Vertical and widescreen formats with HD downloads

## In the Works
- PlantVision: plant identification and care assistant, coming to plantvisionapp.com
- PromptNexus: no-code AI workflows with monitoring (preview, https://promptnexus.ai)

## Our Philosophy
- Safety and observability built into every product
- Human-in-the-loop where it matters
- Ship fast, learn faster
- Stay on-brand for our customers
